# ATC Aasha Tech Coders

> ATC (Aasha Tech Coders) is a software engineering company based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, serving clients worldwide. One team designs, builds and runs complete digital systems for businesses: websites, web applications and SaaS platforms, Android and iOS mobile apps, backend APIs, AI assistants and LLM integrations, business automation, and cloud and DevOps — from discovery and architecture through deployment, monitoring and scale.

Key facts:

- Legal/brand name: ATC Aasha Tech Coders (short name: ATC). "Aasha" means hope. Motto: "Code today, a brighter tomorrow."
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Works with clients worldwide, remotely.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Telugu.
- Who it works with: startup founders, growing businesses and larger organisations that need products, platforms and systems — not just a website.
- Ownership: clients own 100% of the source code, IP and infrastructure; everything is delivered under the client's own accounts.
- Support: fixed-scope projects include a 30-day post-launch bug-fix window; ongoing month-to-month partnership is available with no long-term lock-in.
- No account managers between clients and engineers.
- Getting started: a free 30-minute discovery call, then a written scope and a fixed, milestone-based quote. NDAs signed on request.
- Engagement models: Project sprint (fixed scope and milestones, full handover); Growth partner (monthly engineering and support, pause or scale any month); Enterprise & consulting (dedicated teams, architecture advisory, custom SLAs).
- Contact: aashatechcoders@gmail.com · +91 89789 41066 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/918978941066 · https://aashatechcoders.in/#contact

## Services

- [Web development](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): websites, SaaS platforms, dashboards, customer and partner portals (React, Next.js, TypeScript).
- [Mobile app development](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): Android, iOS and cross-platform apps with Flutter — offline sync, push notifications, maps, payments.
- [Backend engineering](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): APIs, authentication, databases, queues and business logic (Python, Django, FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis).
- [AI development](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): AI assistants and agents, LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over company data, intelligent workflows.
- [Business automation](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): workflow automation and integrations between CRMs, payments, email and internal systems.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): AWS, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Linux, blue-green deployments, monitoring.
- [UI/UX design](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): product interfaces, design systems and interaction design.
- [Custom software](https://aashatechcoders.in/#services): business-specific systems such as CRMs, admin panels, analytics platforms and API platforms.

## Solution blueprints

- [AI Support & Operations Agent](https://aashatechcoders.in/projects/ai-ops-agent/): multi-step AI agent that answers tier-1 support questions, routes tickets and triggers backend workflows, with human escalation.
- [Headless Commerce Platform](https://aashatechcoders.in/projects/headless-ecommerce/): edge-rendered Next.js storefront with Redis caching and a resilient checkout for sale-day traffic.
- [Multi-Tenant SaaS & Billing Platform](https://aashatechcoders.in/projects/b2b-saas-portal/): isolated tenant workspaces, role-based access control and Stripe usage-based billing.
- [Offline-First Fleet & Logistics App](https://aashatechcoders.in/projects/fleet-mobile-app/): Flutter driver app with live tracking, routing and proof-of-delivery that works without signal.
- [Zero-Downtime Cloud & CI/CD Modernisation](https://aashatechcoders.in/projects/cloud-devops-migration/): Dockerised AWS infrastructure with automated test gates and blue-green deployments.
